tech.name: numpy_b_identities

tech.does: fail an identity if it is false on a named field

tech.name: arxiv_atom

tech.cannot: ingest all of science; collapse the wave

tech.name: unittest_checker
tech.why: The anti-bullshit device. Every command has a fail-able test.

tech.name: scipy_or_pyfftw
tech.why: Same Galerkin, faster FFT. Drop-in for T1.
tech.does: larger n on the energy residual

tech.name: dedalus_spectral
tech.why: Public spectral PDE toolkit (Fourier / Chebyshev). Energy checks on A, probes on B.
tech.does: named residual of a named PDE

tech.name: lp_bony_fft
tech.why: Dyadic projectors and Bony T/R from the same FFT already on the desk.

tech.name: lmfdb_pari_sage
tech.why: LMFDB API, Sage/Pari, flint. L-functions, characters, gcd tables.

tech.name: gwosc_pdg_desi
tech.why: GWOSC strain/catalogs, PDG listings, DESI public BAO tables.

tech.name: jax_autodiff_energy
tech.why: Differentiate a discrete energy and check the residual matches the code.
tech.does: catch an algebra bug in the Galerkin step

tech.name: dns_never_blew_up
tech.why: A long smooth run is not a closed estimate for X.

tech.name: qnm_solver_into_b_or_q
tech.why: Kerr QNM codes sit next to EHT/LVK as observation language. Not 1/r^4, not H_N.

tech.name: cosmo_private_core
tech.why: The app equation is not public. No SDK to wire.

tech.name: llm_proves_the_theorem
tech.why: The generator may propose. The checker scores. A model is not a close.
tech.does: emit a sentence for classify / check
